lines: CLAT 2027 Press Release — Click to read the official press release

The Consortium of National Law Universities was established on 19th August, 2017 with the aim of improving standards of legal education in the country and serving the justice system through legal education.

Twenty-Six National Law Universities have joined the Consortium as members. The Consortium aspires to facilitate better coordination amongst National Law Schools to achieve the highest standards of legal education in the country.
The serving President is Prof. (Dr.) Dilip Ukey , Vice-Chancellor, MNLU Mumbai, and Vice-President is Prof. (Dr.) Amar Pal Singh , Vice-Chancellor, RMLNLU, Lucknow.
